people.name: Jacomina/Jacquemina VAN DEVENTER
people.narrative: Die Kaapse Argief se Weeskamer rekords - aanlyn beskikbaar by http://databases.tanap.net/mooc/ (verwysings MOOC8/52.5a, MOOC8/52.5b en MOOC8/52.13) bevat interessante inligting inventaris inligting oor c3 se besittings. Die inventaris is 1 April 1796 gedateer - Johannes is dus in die voorafgaande periode oorlede op 50+ jaar ouderdom. Die inventaris is saamgestel "door de landbouwers Fredrik Hendrik Coenradie, Jacobus Coenradie en Johannes Jonker". Eersgenoemde twee persone is Johannes (c3) se twee broers, respektiewelik c1 en c5. Hieruit wil mens aflei dat die Conradie broers c1, c3 en c5 almal in hierdie periode in die Montagu/Robertson/Klaasvoogds omgewing as boere aktief was. (Johannes Jonker is moontlik? c3d4 se skoonpa). Dit blyk dat Johannes Hendrik (c3) twee leningsplase bedryf het, die hoof leningsplaas was "de Riet Vallij geleegen agter de Cogmans Cloof" Hy het ook 'n kleiner opstal op "de lenings plaats genaamt de Poort geleegen over de Zondags Rivier aan de kant van de Bosjesmans Rivier" gehad - laasgenoemde waarskynlik 'n veepos in die huidige Jansenville omgewing. In een van die inventarise word die naam "Rietfonteyn" vir die veepos aangegee. Dit kom voor of Johannes 'n redelike suksesvolle boer was: Benewens 'n totaal van 12 slawe wat vir hom gewerk het, het hy 14 perde, 35 trekosse, 128 beeste, 154 skape en 305 bokke besit. 'n Addendum lys nog nog 'n verdere 182 aanteelbeeste en 2186 aanteelskape. Ironies was Johannes 2 jaar 6 maande agterstallig met die betaling van sy leningshuur vir Rietvallei, en op die tweede plaas aan die Sondagsrivier was die gelde 7 en 'n half-jaar uitstaande - hy het dit waarskynlik moedswilliglik nooit betaal nie!

people.name: Anna Magrietha OELOFSE
people.narrative: His 1st wife was married formerly to one PIETERSE. g2 was a farmer before World War II; he was sent to war in both North Africa and France. On his return, the government offered him a bicycle, and a job with the railways. He started off as a porter, and ended up as a supervisor. He retired from the railways before they, because of racial issues, emigrated to Australia in 1969. He did not work in Australia (he was 68 when he arrived). He found it hard to settle there - his heart remained in SA - he loved working the land - used to grow vegetables, fruit, kept bees etc. source: Kathryn M. Rogers. July 2007: c3d5e3f5g2h6. Micheline Pauline *30.11.1952 provided this family history: What I know is that my Dad was married before, as you have mentioned. He had three sons with that lady who I think was named Anna. My mom came from the Transkei to Cape Town to study midwifery and they met while Daddy was stationed at army barracks near the Sonnenbloem nursing college in Cape Town. He took a bit of a shine to her and the rest is history. They were married before he went off to war. When he came back they lived in Phillippi where I think my eldest brother David was born on the 10th April, 1948. Hans followed 18 mths later on the 30 October 1950 and then myself on the 30th November, 1952; We moved to The Acres, in Vasco or Goodwood and than to Elsies River in Cape Town where we lived for 10 years until my mother decided we had better get out of South Africa, because, remember my mom was coloured and Daddy was White. Things were not easy for us as a family being in a mixed race family. I really admire and appreciate my Dad for staying with us and giving up his family who ostracised him, except for two of his sons, Abraham (c3d5e3f5g2h2) and Alec (c3d5e3f5g2h1) and my uncle Koos (c3d5e3f5g8) who used to visit us in Elsies River. Mom worked as a midwife on the district in Elsies River and various other places, for many years travelling to patients on bicycle. She learned to drive a mini minor a few years before we left Cape Town. My parents were remarkable people. And I feel blessed to be their daughter. >> Hilda's parents were George Ford Marillier & Maria Ellen Maschado Van Der Bijl. >> The Sydney Morning Herald of Saturday, 13 October 2007 carried this notice: CONRADIE, Hilda Dorothy. Late of Leura, formerly of Blacktown. Much loved wife of Abraham (deceased), loving mother of David and Carmel Hans and Ada and Michelene. Grandmother of Kim, Michael, Rebecca, Nicole, Gordon, Shadan, Frank and Andrew. Great- grandmother of Joshua and Lauren. Aged 90 years. Friend to many. HILDA's relatives and friends are to be advised that a Mass of Christian Burial is to be celebrated on Friday (October 19, 2007), commencing 10 a.m., at St. Bonaventure's Catholic Church, Railway Parade, Leura. At the conclusion of Mass, the cortege will proceed to the Wentworth Falls Cemetery. >>> PART OF EULOGY for Hilda Conradie née Marillier: Hilda Dorothy Marillier was born on the 18th of August, 1917 in the Transkei , South Africa . Descending from an ancient Swiss family and then 1820 British settlers in the Eastern Cape on her father's side, she was brought up with a clear sense of family importance. It was only in later life that she also discovered that her grandmother, Martha Yako, may have been the daughter of a Xhosa chief, making her doubly aristocratic in her antecedents. In her final years she certainly carried herself with a dignity that was almost regal. The success of her parents' trading station afforded boarding school education for all eight children, of whom she was the sixth. The eldest child, her brother Arthur, even went on to study medicine in Glasgow . The isolation of the trading station, however, meant that Hilda was insulated from the wider world until she went away to school, first to Bedford Farm in the Eastern Cape and later all the way to Cape Town . After the idyllic, though lonely, life on the trading station, boarding school was definitely an unwelcome shock. To add to her distress so far from home, both parents died in the early 1930s and her brother Arthur, recently returned from Scotland, advised her to take up the offer of nursing training back in Cape Town . During her time as a nurse she was injured helping to move patients. She carried the consequences of that injury for the rest of her life. She withdrew from nursing only to retrain as a midwife, becoming a neonatal visitor to new mothers in the Western Cape - on her bicycle! With the approach of the Second World War she was approached by a young soldier who wanted her to act as go-between in his romantic pursuit of one of her nursing colleagues. What actually happened was that she herself fell in love with Abraham Conradie. The feelings were mutual and - after a very proper delay and courtship - she and Abraham were married in the Moravian Church on the 20th July 1943. War service intervened and Abraham and Hilda's eldest child, David, did not appear on the scene until 1948. Political changes in South Africa heralded the dawn of the Apartheid era and all that implied for families of such mixed heritage as the growing Conradie family. By the mid 1960's Hilda was finding the social pressures for her and her three children insupportable and began the difficult task of obtaining the necessary papers to emigrate to Australia. In this she was assisted in no small way by sympathetic Catholic priests in both the Cape and here in Australia ... Thus, Hilda, Abraham and their three children came to Sydney in 1969 and began a new and ultimately highly successful life in New South Wales ... written by Glyn Marillier, Perth WA, 16th October 2007: Hilda Dorothy Conradie née Marillier died on Thursday 11th October, 2007 at Katoomba hospital in the Blue Mountains, New South Wales , AUS.

people.name: Susanna Catharina BOTHMA
people.narrative: Hy is oorlede in Huis Ravenzicht, Kraaifontein, maar was voorheen van Ruyterwacht. Michiel Josias se as is op 31 Julie 2010 in Franschhoek by die NG Kerk se Memorial Graftombe geplaas. Die Memorial Graftombe is begin na die Driefontein grafte opgegrawe is om plek te maak vir die bou van die Bergrivierdam. Die Driefontein begraafplaas was geleë in die historiese La Motte plantasie. Die Driefontein begraafplaas is gedurende 2006 verskuif en herbegrawe in die Memorial Graftombe. Die Driefontein begraafplaas het bestaan uit 29 grafte wat behoort het aan die Driefontein gemeenskap wat in die plantasie gewoon en gewerk het sedert vestiging in 1917. Die graftombe is amptelik in gebruik geneem tydens 'n gedenkdiens op 09.11.2006. Susanna Catharina se nis plasing is gedoen op 23.11.2013 by NG Kerk Franschhoek, Graf Tombe van die Drie Fonteine oorskotte.

people.name: Cecilia Hendrina Maria OOSTHUIZEN
people.narrative: Volgens oorlewering {vertel deur sy suster, f4g7, Christina Johanna} was hy 'n Penkop gedurende die Anglo-Boere Oorlog van 1899-1902, en was as krygsgevangene na Ceylon/Sialkot gestuur {'n horlosieketting wat jukskeie uitbeeld, met 'n geweer aan die een punt, en 'POW' daarop gegraveer, is uit been met 'n knipmes gekerf deur David, en is in die besit van sy kleinseun g3h4i1.} As die wapen opgeneem is, het hy alles net so laat vaar en vort gegaan, ongeag die nagevolge. Hy was werksaam by CROWN MINES in Johannesburg, en is gedurende die groot staking {RAND REVOLT} van 1922 in hegtenis geneem, en tronkstraf opgelê. Daar kan nie vasgestel word waarvoor hy aangekla en gevonnis is nie, maar dit word vermoed dat hy deel was van 'n kommando {Strike Commando} wat die Unie- troepe en polisie by Dunswart in 'n hinderlaag gelei het, en die daaropvolgende nederlaag van die Transvaal Scottish onder bevel van Kapt Kirby, wat swaar gewond is. Sy vrou lei aan 'n senu-ineenstorting, en plaas albei haar seuns {g3h3 David Jacob Gideon & 3h4 Gert Johannes} in 'n weeshuis, maar haar twee dogters {g3h5 Catharina Maria & g3h6 Maria Aletta} bly onder haar sorg. Daar is nie veel inligting oor David na sy vrylating nie. Of hy wel weer getrou het is nie bekend nie. Daar word beweer dat hy 'n melkery in Boksburg bedryf het, en dat hy daar saam met 'n vrou gewoon het. >> Navorsing word nog steeds deur sy kleinseun {g3h4i1 Stephanus Richuard} onderneem om die gebeure van die verlede, wat deur familielede toegesmeer is, oop te vleg, en sodoende die ware feite vir sy nageslag te bewaar. Die taak word bemoeilik deur onverkrygbare strafskrifte/registers, asook dokumentasie en briewe wat vernietig is en die afsterwe van familielede.

people.name: Johanna Maria Margaretha RHEEDER
people.narrative: Johanna sterf met die geboorte van g3h3i5 Christiaan Johannes. David het dit moeilik gevind om vir vyf kinders, wat nog baie klein was,{7jr, 5jr, 3jr, 1jr en die pas gebore Christiaan} alleen sonder hulp te sorg, en het Christiaan in die pleegsorg van sy skoonouers RHEEDER, NN geplaas, wat hom later wettiglik aangeneem het.

people.name: Jacoba Sophia LAMPRECHT
people.narrative: Jacoba Sophia het haar naam later wettiglik na "Joan" laat verander; Gert Johannes het as kind in 'n weeshuis in Montagu grootgeword, en is op die ouderdom van 14jr na 'n ambagskool op King Williamstown gestuur waar hy 'n ambag moes leer. Hy het sy ambag as Interieurskilder/binneversierder voltooi, en het saam met sy broer 3h3 David gaan diamante delf. Hulle is hierna terug Fauresmith toe, waarna hy na Johannesburg vertrek het om werk te soek. Gedurende die depressiejare het hy aan die Vaaldam gewerk. Toe die Tweede Wêreld-Oorlog uitbreek, sluit hy by die K Dienstekorps {Q Service Corps} aan, en word eers in 1946 van Robertshoogte in Pretoria ontslaan. In die jare 50 begin hy by die Johannesburg Munisipaliteit te werk tot sy aftrede in 1979. Hy was woonagtig in Fairview, Johannesburg.

people.name: Erika Louise LE ROUX
people.narrative: 'n Dogter Adèl is gebore uit die 1ste huwelik, en 'n dogter Yolandi uit die 2de huwelik. Geen kinders is uit die 3de huwelik gebore nie. Hy het drie stiefkinders, twee seuns en 'n dogter {die dogter het in Des 2009, in Stilbaai, agter op 'n motorfiets verongeluk.} >> In Januarie 1965 sluit hy by die Suid-Afrikaanse Vloot aan, en verlaat die diens in Desember 1966. Hy voltooi sy vakleerlingskap as motorwerktuigkundige in 1971, en doen aansoek vir 'n pos by EVKOM in 1972. In 1978 word hy oorgeplaas na die Opleidingdepartement in Braamfontein as Meganiese Instrukteur {Mobiele Toerusting.} Sy groot liefde vir geskiedenis loop hom vooruit, en in 1984 aanvaar hy die pos as Bestuurder, Historiese Navorsing by ESKOM se Hoofkantoor, Megawatt Park. Hy was verantwoordelik vir die Argief en navorsing van ESKOM se geskiedenis, asook die versameling van oudhede landwyd m.b.t. ESKOM se Erfenisprogram. As gevolg van regstellende aksie neem hy 'n pakket in 1994, en verhuis na Stilbaai in die Suid-Kaap. In 2000 word hy deur Allen Morgan, Uitvoerende Hoof van ESKOM, genader om 'n boek te skryf aangaande ESKOM se geskiedenis. Die taak word in 2002 voltooi met Jac Messerschmidt as medeskrywer. Die boek word op 3.11.2002 vrygestel deur Chris van Rensburg Publications. Hy woon in Stilbaai, en is 'n professionele messemaker, asook lid van die Cape Knifemakers Guild. >>> 2011 adr: Albetroslaan 9, Stilbaai.

people.name: Johanna Elizabeth BRINK
people.narrative: sy geboorte datum is ook opgegee as 10 Feb 1873. Toe hy op 20 april 1889 voorgestel is op Prins Albert, was sy ouers se woonplek aangegee as "Jan Fourie's Kraal". Johanna Elizabeth Conradie het haar sedert 1929 beywer vir die welsyn van "kreupeles", en tydens 'n konferensie wat op 25 Februarie 1937 in Kaapstad gehou was, het die Kaaplandse Kreupelsorg ontstaan, waarvan sy die lewenslange Presidente geword het. In Junie 1939 is die Nasionale Raad vir Kreupelsorg gestig, en in 1948 is sy verkies tot Presidente van die Nasionale Raad. Die Universiteit van Stellenbosch het in 1953 'n ere-doktorsgraad aan haar toegeken, en op 1 April 1955 besluit die Departement van Nasionale Opvoeding dat die nou bekende skool in Kimberley na Dr Elizabeth Conradie vernoem moet word. (SESA deel 3); CONRADIE, Mevr. JOHANNA ELIZABETH CONRADIE, Mevr. JOHANNA ELIZABETH, gebore Brink, eggenote van Sy Edele die Administrateur, Mnr. J. H. Conradie. Gebore in die distrik van Mosselbaai, K.P. en onderwys ontvang te Mosselbaai. Het een seun, Alex. Marais. Was onderwyseres te Mosselbaai, distrik en dorp, vir 7 jaar. Na haar huwelik in 1906 her sy etlike jare in Kaapstad gewoon. In 1912 is haar eggenoot tot Superintendent van die groot Arbeidsneder-setting te Kakamas benoem en daar is byna 8 jaar deurgebring waar sy 'n groot rol in die samelewing van die nedersetters gevul het en hulle met raad en daad bygestaan het. Vanaf 1920 het Mnr. Conradie Prieska (tans Gordonia) in die Volksraad verteenwoordig en nadat hulle op George vir 'n paar jaar gewoon het, het hulle in 1925 na Kaapstad teruggekeer. Byna vanaf die stigting van die Vroue Nasionale Party het Mevr. Conradie op die Hoofbestuur gedien en later as Presidente opgetree. Hierdie hoë posisie het sy tot 1929 beklee, toe haar eggenoot as Administrateur aangestel is. As Administrateursvrou word sy uiters besig gehou as lid van die besture van verskillende sosiale en liefdadigheidsverenigings van Kaapland en die Unie. Onlangs is haar die onderskeiding te beurt geval om as Kommandeur (Suster) van die Geërbiedigde Orde van St. John van Jerusalem ingesweer te word. Ontspanning is tuinbou, en haar adres is "Leeuwenhof," Hofstraat, Kaapstad. [bron Women of South Africa 1935] >> Johannes het op Calitzdorp groot geword. Hy het hom op 'n onderwys- loopbaan toegelê. Het op 17 jaar as onderwyser na Christiana, Transvaal gegaan. Op 24-jarige leeftyd is hy as hoof van die Grey-kollege in Bloemfontein aangestel. In die Tweede Vryheids- oorlog is hy deur die Britte gevange geneem, maar ná 'n ruk op parool vrygelaat, waarna hy hom op Stellenbosch gevestig het. Na die vrede in 1902 het hy hom as klerk by 'n prokureur laat inskryf, en is 1905 as sulks toegelaat. Van 1905 tot 1912 Finansiële Sekretaris in die Kerkkantoor, Kaapstad. In 1912 is hy as superintendent van die arbeid- skolonie op Kakamas aangestel. Agt jaar later, en daarna weer in 1924, is hy, as 'n kandidaat van die Nasionale Party, tot lid van die Volksraad vir die kiesafdeling Prieska verkies. In 1929 is hy aangestel as administrateur van Kaapland - 'n betrekking wat hy tien jaar lank beklee het. (SESA deel 3) Die Conradie-hospitaal in Pinelands is na hom vernoem (1951). SAWB inskrywing: Conradie, Johannes Hendrik (Subscriber Content)(*Prince Albert, 10.2.1872 - †Little Brak River, 21.1.1940), Administrator, was the son of David Jacob Gideon Conradie and his wife, Geertruida Jacoba Koorts. C. was educated at Calitzburg where his father was a teacher. He soon gave proof of his intelligence by passing the 'School Hogereksamen' (Junior Certificate) with distinction, but at the age of sixteen he had to leave school and take up a position as a shop assistant. Because of the trade depression which set in after the fall in the price of ostrich feathers, he had to find other work. Before his seventeenth year he became a teacher at Christiana, in the Transvaal Republic, at a school which had been opened by Mathilda König, who later married General C. F. Beyers.* A year later he became an itinerant teacher at the neighbouring town of Boshof in the Orange Free State where he taught with great success for five years. During this time he passed the Free State examination in Literature and Science by private study, and subsequently also the Matriculation Examination. On the recommendation of Dr J. Brill,* the Free State Superintendent of Education, he was appointed, in 1895, teacher of Dutch and also vice-principal of Grey College in Bloemfontein. He was hardly twenty-four years old when he was appointed principal of this school. On the outbreak (11.10.1899) of the Second Anglo-Boer War he enlisted as a volunteer with the Free State armed forces on the western boundary and took part in the battles of Rooilaagte (25.11.1899), Modder River (28.11.1899) and Magersfontein (11.12.1899). In January 1900 he was asked by the board of trustees of his school to return to teaching and when the British occupied Bloemfontein in March of that year he continued in his post. As he refused to take the oath of allegiance to the new regime he was jailed, but on the intercession of J. G. (later Sir) John Fraser,* whose sons attended C.'s school, he was released on parole and sent back to the Cape Colony. This ended his career as a teacher. Returning to Stellenbosch he passed the Intermediate Examination of the University of the Cape of Good Hope and enrolled as an attorney's clerk, and although in 1905 he was admitted as an attorney, he never practised as such. From 1905 to 1912 he acted as financial secretary of the N.G. Kerk office in Cape Town and afterwards, until 1920, as superintendent of the labour settlement of this church at Kakamas. There he became well acquainted with the people of the north-western Cape and acquired a sound knowledge of their problems. His interest in politics started in 1904 when, during his stay at Stellenbosch, he acted as electoral officer for J. H. (Jannie) Marais* and G. J. Krige and was jointly responsible for their success at the polls against the candidates of Dr L. S. Jameson's* Progressive Party. In the general election of 1920 he won the House of Assembly constituency of Prieska for the National Party but lost the seat in the election in the following year. He was later appointed assistant organising secretary of the Cape National Party. In 1924 he won back the constituency of Prieska (later Gordonia) and succeeded C. W. M. (Charlie) Malan* as secretary of the National Party. As a member of the House of Assembly he did not often take part in the debates but when matters arose about which he had a thorough knowledge, such as irrigation, he had a very attentive audience. Under the pseudonym 'Mossie' he was responsible for a regular feature in Die Burger which showed his ability as a political observer and his exceptional skill with the pen. He retained his seat in the election of 1929 but, in the same year, was appointed Administrator of the Cape. The severe depression of the early thirties made his task extremely difficult because stringent economy measures had to be enforced. During these difficult years he acted with great circumspection and managed the affairs of the province with marked success. He gained the respect of his political opponents to such an extent that when the United Party came into power in 1934 he was re-appointed Administrator. In spite of deteriorating health he carried out his task with great devotion. On 6.9.1939 he finally withdrew from public life and settled at Little Brak River, near Mossel Bay. In 1906 C. married Johanna E. Brink, a sister of George Brink, a former M.P. for George, and had one son. There is a photograph of him in Die nasionale boek (infra) and in the S.A.W.W., (1938). D. W. KRÜGER

Sam se ouers: William LIVERSAGE *27 Sep 1829 †13 Jun 1905 en Johanna Susanna UYS *15 May 1835 †18 Feb 1904. Vier LIVERSAGE kinders is bekend: (1) William LIVERSAGE (Bill); (2) Frederick Jacobus LIVERSAGE *06.01.1899 x Marie Dorothy RUDRAM * 6 Aug 1904, †23 Jul 1979; Boksburg. > As a boy of 8 he was out hunting, when he was bitten by a snake. He used the rifle strap as tourniquet, and tightened it by twisting the rifle. He battled to get home. Gangrene set in, and the leg had to be amputated (on the kitchen table). He always used one crutch - no hindrance, and could do anything from driving a car to clearing an 8 foot fence. 5 Children: (2.1) *21 Sep 1925 Samuel Ernest LIVERSAGE; (2.2) *10 Nov 1927 Anton William LIVERSAGE; (2.3) *6 Jun 1929 Frederick Jacobus LIVERSAGE (Boksburg); (2.4) *24 Feb 1936 Dennis Edward LIVERSAGE; (2.5) *22 Jul 1939 Ronald John LIVERSAGE; (3) Dirkie Aletta LIVERSAGE x Jan Gotlieb Fourie BARKHUIZEN (5377) *15 Jul 1888 †30 Nov 1940; Johannesburg.; (4) Johanna Susanna LIVERSAGE x Willem Johannes PIETERSE.

people.name: Samuel Daniel BOTHMA
people.narrative: f6 is hier geplaas as 'n veronderstelde (presumed) kind van e5. Dit is moontlik die "Hendrina" wat in SA Geslagsregister (1986) gelys word. Volgens e5 se SK is die naam 'n onleesbare Hermina of Jacomina. Sy was 'n doopgetuie in 1875 by f2g2 se doop. f6 se sterfkennis gee haar ouers as Frederick (klop nie) en Annie (klop). Volgens die kinders se doopinskrywings, meld meer as een dat Samuel van Tarkastad gekom het, en f6 vanaf Boshof. Samuel se van word 7 keer as BOTHMA gespel, een keer as BOTMA, en een keer as BOTMAN. Haar van word 8 keer as Conradie gespel, en een keer as Coenradie. Die volgende kinders is almal by die NGK Kimberley gedoop: (1) Johannes *27Okt76; (2) David Daniel *27Jul78; (3) Samuel Daniel *05Aug80; (4) George Steÿtler de Villiers *09Okt82; (5) Louis James *23Mrt85 getuie = James Louis Conradie f8 onder; (6) Annie Maria *30Jun87; (7) Andrew Henry *15Des89 getuies = Johann Georg Conradie & Sara Frederika Conradie (8) Hester Elizabeth *12Jan93; (9) David Daniel *01Okt96 getuies = James MITCHELL en Anna Cecilia f5 hierbo. Several of Jacomina Maria's daughters-in-law died leaving young children. These children did not go to the mother's family as is usual but all were raised by their paternal grandmother, and even when the fathers re-married several of them stayed with Ouma. One daughter died in the Spanish Flu epidemic in 1918, and her son and daughter were among the kids at Ouma's house and they never returned permanently to their father's house. Jacomina was very strict with them, and even after the girls married she paid unexpected visits to check up if they were doing the house-work to her standards! She died at age 72 yrs 5 mnths in the general hospital in Johannesburg; she then lived at 59 Fourth Street, Vrededorp in Johannesburg. SK

people.name: Maria Johanna Cornelia MARSH
people.narrative: The marriage was performed by the resident magistrate, Kimberley and recorded thus: "No 318; 23 September 1891; James Louis CONRADIE, bachelor, guard, full age, of Kimberley; Maria Johanna Cornelia MARSH, spinster, 17 years, of Kimberley." In later life, his name was always recorded as "James Louis"; His DN (MOK 1/1/338 R8/411 & MOK 1/4/147 56) states that he was Head Warden at the De Beers Convict Station. He owned a house & stand at 8 Anderson Road, West End, Kimberley. This was sold in 1921 for 450 Pounds. Maria's father was Joseph MARSH *c.1843 & married at Mossel Bay on 23 Nov 1869 to Elizabeth Johanna Christina VAN HEES. Joseph then was a clerk at Mossel Bay. Both Joseph and his wife were present as godparents in Kimberley in 1896 at the baptism of g3. After f8 had died, Maria subsequently married an unknown Bates man.

people.name: Verda Muriel BOUWER
people.narrative: Verda Muriel BOUWER, d.v. Jan Jonathan BOUWER en Philipina Rudolphina NEL, was eerste met Louw LABUSCHAGNE getroud, maar skei na sy twee kinders by Labuschagne het, en trou met Eugene Conradie by wie sy 'n dogter Genette het, en na Eugene se dood trou sy weer met Francois BIEWENGA - 'n jonger broer van Tjasse BIEWENGA hier onder gemeld. Francois maak Genette soos 'n eie kind groot. Eugene George se sterfkennis verwysing is MHG 5337/53 en daarvolgens was sy beroep "Inspector in Industries". Sy geboorteplek word as Touwsrivier aangegee, maar geen ouderdom of geboortedatum word gemeld nie - hy het ook geen testament nie. Volgens oorlewering het die familie verneem: Eugene George Conradie sou Medies geswot het (wat Verda help betaal het), en hy is in Johannesburg oorlede in sy vroeë 30’s. Hy het in daardie tyd in Bree Straat Hillbrow gebly. Verda het in Johannesburg Algemene Hospitaal gewerk as hooftikster waar Eugene George gewerk het. 'n Aanname is dat hulle daar ontmoet het.

people.name: Hermannus 03.02.1942 BIEWENGA
people.narrative: Hermannus is s.v. Tjasse BIEWENGA en Johanna Elizabeth STEYN wat op die familie-plaas "Horing", distrik Gobabis, geboer het. Genette se seun Francois BIEWENGA skryf in 2012: Biewenga is ‘n nederlandse van. Oorsprong van die familie plaas Bijwengaheerd in Biewengalaan tussen ‘t Zandt en Loppersum in Groningen Nederland. My Groot oupa was Ds. Pieter Biewenga wat in 1894 saam met Ds CJH Vorster by die Dorslandtrekkers aangesluit het in Humpata, Angola. Ds CJH Vorster was daardie tyd beroep om Ds. Postman te vervang. Ds. Pieter Biewenga het as onderwyser opgetree en het skool gegee vir die Makvolk soos wat hulle bekend gestaan het daardie tyd. Hy is in 1906 beroep om vir die gemeente in Bihé as predikant op te tree en in 1928 het hy saam met die Dorslandtrekkers na Gobabis Namibia getrek. My Oupa Tjasse was die 4de oudste kind van 23 Kinders en het die familie plaas Horing oorgeneem by Ds P Biewenga (Daardie jare het die Dorslandtrekkers plase in Gobabis distrik van die SA Regering gekoop.) toe ds P Biewenga na Pietersburg toe verhuis het. Dis ook waar hy oorlede is. BIEWENGA kind (1) Francois Biewenga > In 2012 is Francois rekenmeester by ATC African Travel Concept in Kaapstad en doen familie navorsing oor sy voorgeslagte.

people.name: Johanna Gertruida VAN DER WESTHUIZEN
people.narrative: Sy seun Johan (h3i3) skrywe oor sy vader: "Dit is met dankbare herinneringe wat ek dit skryf. Ons het as gesin met sy dood 'n bidder verloor. Hy het letterlik ons en ons land voortdurend in gebed voor die Here gebring. 'n Man met 'n ongelooflike geheue. Wat hy gelees het, het hy onthou. 'n Uitstaande kenner van die Bybel. Hy het sy Meestersgraad in teologie verwerf in 1954, met die titel: “Scriptura sui ipsus interpres”. (Die Skrif is sy eie uitlegger.) Dis gedoen onder mentorskap van Prof Jac. J. Muller. (Die oorspronklike kopie is in my besit.) In sy voorwoord vertel my pa, dat hy nog 'n klein seuntjie was, toe sy pa (c3d6e7f2g2 Andries Frederik Pretorius), gemeld het van 'n man wat “magtig was in die Skrifte”. Dit het so 'n indruk op hom gemaak, as klein seuntjie, dat hy hom voorgeneem het om ook so te wees en dit was die begin van sy roeping om predikant te word. (Sy pa was 'n onderwyser. Ek onthou die naam Jonkersberg. Ek meen dit was in George omgewing. Later is hulle na Robertson. Of hy (oupa) toe afgetree was en of hy ook daar onderwyser was, weet ek nie.) In moeilike tye het my pa sy studies aan die Univ van Stellenbosch voltooi en in 1936 was hy eers “hulpprediker” in Port Elizabeth moedergemeente, onder Ds WA Landman. (Ds WA Landman het, in my pa se teenwoordigheid, in 1936 'n baba gedoop met die name Catharina Wilhelmina Landman, wat later sy tweede vrou geword het, my ma. Hulle het 25 jaar in ouderdom verskil. So amper of my pa het sy tweede vrou gedoop!) Hy is toe na Barkly Wes, steeds as hulpprediker (proponent in vandag se tyd) en is in Stella bevestig as predikant. (datum onseker – om en by 1940). Daarna was hy predikant in Sondagsrivier-Suid. Sy eerste vrou het selfmoord gepleeg in 1955 en hom gelaat met twee kinders: Johanna Getruida en Andries Frederik. Sy tweede huwelik met Catharina Wilhelmina (Rina), op 8.9.1956 in Uitenhage. In 1962 is ons Butterworth toe, in die destydse Transkei. Vanaf 1965 tot 1977 was ons op Cathcart, waar ek gematrikuleer het. Daar het hy weens finansiële redes van die gemeente sy emeritaat aanvaar. Hy doen verdere afloswerk in gemeentes, waarvan De Aar Suid, 1978, die eerste was. Ek is in 1986 georden in De Aar Suid. 1978 afloswerk in Griekwastad. In 1979 doen hy afloswerk in Daniëlskuil, NG Kerk in Afrika. Daar word hy versoek om hom beroepbaar te stel en word hy weer bevestig as predikant. In 1983 tree hy uit die bediening en vestig hom op Graaff-Reinet. Tydens 'n kuier by ons in De Aar, is hy op 26.7.1995 oorlede. 'n Dag voor sy dood, op 25.7.1995, is in dieselfde hospitaal, sy kleindogter Marcelle Theron, gebore. Hy kon haar nog in sy arms hou. Hy kon nooit ophou studeer nie. Voor sy dood het hy vir sy doktorale studies in Ou Testament ingeskryf, met sy seun Andries Frederik as promotor. (Hy was toe Prof in Semitiese tale aan die Univ van die Noorde.) Hy kon nie daardie graad voltooi nie. 'n Paar dae voor sy dood het hy nog gesê dat hy nou gesond wil word om sy studies klaar te maak. Hy het altyd gesê dat hy spyt was dat hy nie Grieks as hoofvak geneem het nie. Hy het eerder Sielkunde 3 geneem, onder Dr Hendrik Verwoerd as dosent. In 1981 het hy Grieks III aan UNISA voltooi. Hy was iemand wat sterk in tale was: suiwer Afrikaans en suiwer Engels. Ek wens my kinders kon hom langer as oupa geken het. As ek mag sê, hoe trots sou hy gewees het op sy kleinseun (Marthinus Stander) wat sy doktorsgraad in Engels behaal het. Vanuit sy doktorale studie het 6 artikels in internasionale akademiese joernale verskyn."

people.name: Samantha Fiona Russell BOLTON
people.narrative: NGKerk predikant, studie voltooi 1979, 1982 Semitiese Tale, Univ van die Noorde, 1992 uit die bediening. Professor vir Afro- Asiatiese studies by Univ. van die Noorde. 2006: I am Andre Conradie, born in Port Elizabeth South Africa. I grew up in the Eastern Province and Border areas and studied in Stellenbosch, near Cape Town. I then lectured at the University of the North (now University of Limpopo) near Pietersburg/ Polokwane in the far north of South Africa, not far from the Tropic of Capricorn. Holder of Fulbright (USA), British Council and Commonwealth (UK) Fellowships and received financial support and stipends from the German Academic Exchange Service, as well as the Deutsche Forschungsgemeinschaft for linguistic and philological research at post-doctoral level in Germany, the UK and the USA. 2012: Woon in Berlyn, Duitsland. Werk ondermeer as vertaler Duits na Engels.

people.name: Johannes Hendri VAN WYK
people.narrative: Die Burger se Willem de Vries skrywe op 30 Jan 2013: Anna-Louize Heiberg (88) was ’n skrywer wat haar tyd vooruit was. Só bestempel die digter Petra Müller die bydrae van prof. Anna-Louize Heiberg, in lewe ’n romanskrywer, ook onder die naam Anna-Louize Conradie, en professor in filosofie aan verskeie Suid-Afrikaanse universiteite. Sy het in die Berghof-aftreeoord in Tuine, Kaapstad, gewoon, waar sy volgens van haar vriende in haar laaste jare ’n kluisenaarsbestaan gevoer het. Sy is Vrydag daar oorlede. Müller het gesê Heiberg het destyds ’n ander soort boek geskryf as waaraan Afrikaanse lesers in die 1940’s en 1960’s gewoond was. “Dit was in die sfeer van Virginia Woolf: ’n intense beskrywing van die vrou se binnelewe – gans te modern tóé.” Uit die pen van Heiberg tel die sielkundige romans Laura (1942) en Nuwe Gebooie (1943) en die simboliese romans Dans Makaber (1966) en Dambord (1969). “Haar werk was baie op sigself ingekeer. Sy het oor die binnelewe van die vrou geskryf op ’n manier wat D.H. Lawrence en Woolf geskryf het: ’n diep, innerlike studie,” het Müller bygevoeg. Heiberg laat twee dogters, Marilize King en Karien Heiberg, en twee seuns, Hannes van Wyk en Ludvig Heiberg, agter, asook ses kleinkinders. >> Last, as we round off some of the major South African Calvinist thinkers in this period prior to the establishment of the Republic of South Africa in 1961, we mention Professor Anna Louise Conradie. She trained under Professor Dr. Andrew H. Murray, the grandson of the great Preacher Andrew Murray, in the Department of Philosophy at the University of Cape Town. She subsequently became Professor of Philosophy at the University of Natal. [Source: THE CHRISTIAN AFRIKANERS - A Brief History of Calvinistic Afrikanerdom from 1652 - 1980 by Rev. Prof. Dr. Francis Nigel Lee]

people.name: Maria Dorothea BOSHOFF
people.narrative: Hy was in sy studente dae 'n inwoner van huis Hombré op Stellenbosch. Hy verwerf die grade BA (1944), HonsBA (1964) Predikant NGK: Ds. Conradie was 39 jaar in die bediening. Die Conradies het 'n lang verbintenis met Stellenbosch - sedert hul studentedae en ook as leraarspaar van die NG gemeente Sentraal. Hy is in 1949 gelegimiteer, en was leraar op Riversdal, Bredasdorp, De Doorns, en in Bellville- Wes en Durbanville. In die Eikestad is hulle veral bekend vir hul mensliewenheid en opregte belangstelling in die wel en wee van die gemeentelede. Hulle het oor die jare 'n besondere verbintenis met Stellenbosch se jong mense gehad. Ds. Conradie was lank voorsitter van die ACSV en ook twintig jaar lank voorsitter van die Admissiekomitee van die Teologiese Kweekskool van die Universiteit van Stellenbosch. Het in April 1989 na 16 jaar by die Stellenbosse NG Moederkerk emeriteer. In 1999 lid van die Conradie Werda-komitee. En steeds in 2009! Dottie se dankdiens was op 25.07.2009 in die NG Moederkerk in Stellenbosch. Sy Dankdiens was op 06.07.2010 in die NG Moederkerk in Stellenbosch.

people.name: Jacobus Gerhardus ROOS
people.narrative: Sy was 'n verpleegster tot hulle troue in 1959. Sy het by Moedersbond in Pretoria opleiding gehad; werk later in Mowbray Kraaminrigting. Hulle woon met die kinders in Parow. Susanna en Jacobus is een oggend in hulle huis deur 'n inbreker oorval; na 10 kapwonde met 'n mes, sterf sy. Jacobus was erg beseer; Hy was een van 9 kinders; werk as 'n treindrywer op die spoorweë; tree af in 1976; Na Susanna se dood is sy 3de huwelik met Aletta Johanna LAMBRECHT, een jaar en een dag na g12 se dood. Hulle gaan woon op Kleinmond, en was baie gelukkig saam, en geliefd deur almal. Hy is op 85 jaar oorlede aan hartversaking. 2011: Aletta is ook reeds oorlede. ROOS kinders: (1) Sandra Martha *28.05.1960 x BASSON, Jordaan Petrus > Sandra is na haar ma se ma vernoem, aangesien daar so 'n magdom Susanna's in die familie is wyk g12 toe af van die normale en noem haar Sandra Martha. Die oudste broer was glo nie baie beindruk met dié naam nie. 2011: Hulle woon in die Paarl. BASSON kinders: (1.1) Suzanne; (1.2) Johannes Jacobus; (2) Jacobus Gerhardus *17.06.1962. x CORNELISSEN, Johanna Elizabeth % xx HOUGH, Jeonie > Hy is na sy pa se oupa aan vaderskant vernoem aangesien sy eie pa ook JG moes wees en oupa het gevra dat die regte familienaam aan hom gegee word. Geen kinders of stiefkinders by 2de vrou. 2011: Woon in Citrusdal. CORNELISSEN kinders by 1ste vrou: (2.1) Regardt; (2.2) Martea; (3) Magaretha Maria *15.12.1963 x GROENEWALD, Josias Stephanus > Sy is na haar pa se ma vernoem. g12 het die 3de naam "Cornelia" weggelaat. 2011: Woon in die Paarl. GROENEWALD kinders: (3.1) Marissa; (3.2) Louis Stephanus; (3.3) Etienne.

people.name: Johanna Lourensia KOTZE
people.narrative: Gert Willem was 'n buite-egtelike kind van Anna Gertina Wilhelmina SWANEPOEL. Sy naam is in die Robertson NGK Moederkerk doopregister, met doopgetuies Susannna Elizabeth Maria Swanepoel (sy moeder se suster) en ene Hendrik Lotz); die register gee sy vader se naam as "Gert Willem Conradie". Anna Gertina Wilhelmina SWANEPOEL is nooit met die vader getroud nie, maar registreer die kind met as CONRADIE. Anna Gertina is op 28.01.1922 met Johannes Diederick VERMAAK (gebore 06.07.1895) getroud; sy en Vermaak het 3 kinders gehad wat almal jonk dood is. Anna Gertina is op ongeveer 26 jaar ouderdom oorlede en Vermaak is weer in die eg verbind; hy en sy vrou het GERT WILLEM CONRADIE verder grootgemaak. Gert Willem se biologiese pa is onbekend. Gert Willem het glo per geleentheid aan Maria Dorothea (met wie hy op 21.05.1939 getroud is) vertel dat hy een van 'n tweeling was. Die tweeling boetie is glo dood by geboorte, en begrawe op Zandvliet, Ashton. Gert Willem het op 'n later stadium aan sy eerste drie kinders (Maureen, Annalene en Johan) die graf gaan wys. Een van Gert Willem se "Vermaak susters" heet Joey VAN OUDTSHOORN en was in 2004 woonagtig te Evander. In sy jongdae was Gert Willem verbonde aan die Weermag, en was ook onder andere 'n werktuigkundige by 'n motorhawe (Bruwer Motors) in Reitzstraat, Robertson. Hy was glo ook vir 'n tydperk werksaam by 'n versekeringsfirma. Terwyl Gert Willem met Maria Dorotha (Botha) (02/12/1912) getroud was, het hy ook 'n seun Bennet Murray (Ben) *07.03.1943 gehad by Susanna Frederika KOEN (gebore 22.03.1925) - op daardie stadium woonagtig George Distrik. Gert Willem en Susanna KOEN is nooit getroud nie, maar sy is op 28.12.1943 met Daniel Andries MULLER *09.08.1918 wie ook vir Bennet Murray (Ben) wettiglik aangeneem het op ongeveer 6 jarige ouderdom.

people.name: Alta
people.narrative: Hy het meer as 30jr onder meer as handsetter in die Burger se settery gewerk nadat hy vroeër in diens van die Suid-Afrikaanse Spoorweë was. Hy het in 2007 afgetree. Hy het in Kaapstad grootgeword en na se aftrede na Fraserburg verhuis. Hy is na 'n hartaanval oorlede. Hy was 22 jaar lank met Alta getroud. Hulle het 2 dogters. Hy het dikwels sy kitaar uitgehaal het en musiek gemaak het terwyl daar gekuier is. Bron: Berig in die Burger geskryf deur Jodine Cloete.
